subject: Cyclone AI RFP — bakeoff credit & usage safeguards
messages:
From: Jamie Lee <jamie@cycloneai.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 19:04:00 -0500
Subject: Cyclone AI RFP — request for trial top-up and safeguards

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile looked promising. We have an upcoming RFP bake‑off against two incumbents the week of Dec 6 and need a short-term evaluation environment. Procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a trial top‑up (preferably prepaid credits) and whether we can agree to usage guardrails so the credits are only used for the bakeoff evaluation.

High level:
- Two‑week window (Dec 6–20)
- Expect ~50–75k tokens/day during heavy test runs
- Need a mutual action plan and access to logs for verification

Can you share what you can offer (credits, duration, access controls) and any terms you require? If you need a formal MSA/NDAs in advance, cc’ing procurement: procurement@cycloneai.com.

Best,
Jamie
Jamie Lee
Head of Platform Integrations
Cyclone AI

Attachment: RFP_Scope_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Jamie Lee <jamie@cycloneai.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cyclone AI RFP — request for trial top-up and safeguards

Jamie — appreciate the details and the timeline. We can absolutely support a short, constrained bakeoff. High‑level proposal from our side:

- Conditional credit: $6,000 equivalent (~120k tokens) applied to a scoped evaluation project
- Duration: 2 weeks (can be scheduled Dec 6–20)
- Guardrails: tagged project with read‑only audit logs, per‑day burn cap, and automated alerts if usage spikes outside expected pattern
- Verification: we’ll share token usage reports and can enable temporary reporting access to a Cyclone AI admin

I’m looping in Vanessa (goes to dedicated approvals) — internally we’ll need a short MAP and bookkeeping for the subsidy. If that looks acceptable I’ll route the approval.

Would you be able to share a short MAP (milestones, evaluation success criteria, point of contact) — happy to start a one‑page doc.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Cyclone AI RFP — bakeoff credit request (needs approval)

FYI — Cyclone AI wants a constrained evaluation credit for a bakeoff in early Dec. Proposal above: $6k credit (~120k tokens), 2‑week window, with project tagging and usage caps.

Key asks for approvals:
- Vanessa: ok to approve $6k as a subsidized evaluation credit for this account (they’re target enterprise, likely expansion)
- Priyom: confirm we can issue the credit now and whether we need to put it in an escrow threshold or incremental top‑ups controlled by ops
- Marissa: can you draft a quick MAP template (one page) we can send back to Jamie? I’ll include the guardrails and reporting cadence.

Considerations: Cyclone is running an RFP vs two competitors; we should gate by identity verification and audit logs so credits aren’t repurposed. Also prefer to avoid open‑ended credits — incremental release is fine.

Thanks,
Rishi

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cyclone AI RFP — bakeoff credit request (needs approval)

Agree with the conditional $6k credit with guardrails. Approve provided we implement the following operational controls:

- Project tagging + ACL so only Cyclone’s designated users can consume the credit
- Daily cap at 75k tokens, with a hard stop if hourly rate exceeds expected profile by >200%
- Require Cyclone to sign the standard evaluation terms (see attached sample) and confirm the MAP
- Finance: credits should be issued as a locked promo ID, with Ops able to revoke mid‑trial if misuse detected

Priyom — can your team set the promo token and revoke path? If not, propose we do two 3k releases (week 1 / week 2) contingent on usage review at mid‑point.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

- Timing: valid Dec 6 00:00 PST — Dec 20 23:59 PST
- Release mechanics: two releases of $3k each. Second release occurs after a mid‑point usage review on Dec 12; Ops can revoke on confirmed misuse.
- Guardrails: project tag, daily cap 75k tokens, hourly spike alerting, read‑only audit logs to a shared reporting view.

Requirements from Cyclone AI
- Signed evaluation terms (attached) and a one‑page MAP (deliverable milestones & POC contact) — please fill and return by Nov 30.
- Admin list (emails) for whom we enable reporting access

Next steps

3) If you want more headroom we can discuss additional credits after the mid‑point review.

If that all sounds good I’ll ask Ops to provision the promo ID and schedule the mid‑point check.

Thanks and good luck with the RFP prep — let me know if you want a brief sync before Dec 6.
